# Jotform

> > Jotform is a no-code online form builder and workflow automation platform enabling users to create surveys, collect payments, and streamline business processes.

Jotform provides a drag-and-drop form creator with extensive integrations including Google and Apple services, allowing businesses and individuals to build custom forms, automate workflows, and collect data without coding knowledge.
